scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run deps && npm run knip && npm run docs && npm run openapi > /dev/null && npm run suppressions && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/apps/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.app:pack: node scripts/app-pack.ts tests/apps/recados dist/apps/recados-1 && node scripts/app-pack.ts tests/apps/recados dist/apps/recados-2 tests/apps/recados/cor-2 && node scripts/app-pack.ts tests/apps/recados dist/apps/recados-nao-inicia tests/apps/recados-nao-inicia && node scripts/app-pack.ts tests/apps/recados dist/apps/recados-defeito tests/apps/recados-defeito && node scripts/app-pack.ts tests/apps/recados dist/apps/recados-laco tests/apps/recados-laco
scripts.pree2e: npm run build -w @conexus/server && npm run build -w @conexus/web && npm run app:pack && npm exec -w @conexus/web -- playwright-core install chromium-headless-shell
scripts.e2e: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=300000 --test-reporter=./scripts/test-reporter.ts tests/e2e/invitation.test.ts tests/e2e/client.test.ts tests/e2e/projects.test.ts tests/e2e/two-companies.test.ts tests/e2e/remove-person.test.ts tests/e2e/app.test.ts tests/e2e/app-open.test.ts tests/e2e/versions.test.ts tests/e2e/refusals.test.ts tests/e2e/model-accounts.test.ts tests/e2e/conversation.test.ts tests/e2e/defaults.test.ts tests/e2e/house.test.ts tests/e2e/builder-writes.test.ts tests/e2e/builder-builds.test.ts
